name: Pituitary Hormone Deficiency of Vascular Origin

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Biochemical Criteria for Hypopituitarism of Vascular Origin

criteria.description: Presence of symptoms consistent with pituitary hormone deficiencies following a vascular event (e.g., pituitary apoplexy, Sheehan's syndrome)
Biochemical evidence of one or more anterior pituitary hormone deficiencies confirmed by laboratory testing
MRI or CT evidence of pituitary infarction, hemorrhage, or ischemic changes
Exclusion of other causes of hypopituitarism such as tumors, infiltrative diseases, or genetic causes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Clinical symptoms consistent with pituitary hormone deficiency, biochemical confirmation of hormone deficits, and imaging evidence of vascular insult to the pituitary gland
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often follows an acute vascular event such as postpartum hemorrhage (Sheehan's syndrome) or pituitary apoplexy.

pathognomonic.notes: Due to LH and FSH deficiency

searchTerms: lack of energy caused by adrenal hormone shortage
low blood pressure from cortisol shortage
hypotension due to adrenal hormone deficiency

occasional.symptomName: Anemia due to pituitary hormone deficiency
searchTerms: low red blood cells from pituitary hormone loss
headache after stroke or blood vessel event
headache following brain blood flow problem

rare.notes: Rarely involved in vascular pituitary injury

laboratory: Low serum cortisol with low or inappropriately normal ACTH
Low free T4 with low or normal TSH
Low LH and FSH with low sex steroids
imaging: MRI showing pituitary infarction, hemorrhage, or empty sella
CT scan evidence of pituitary apoplexy or ischemic changes
other: History of acute vascular event such as postpartum hemorrhage or pituitary apoplexy

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of pituitary mass on imaging
Gradual onset rather than acute vascular event
Often associated with other autoimmune diseases

redFlags: Acute severe headache with visual disturbances
Rapid onset of adrenal crisis symptoms
Postpartum hemorrhage history with delayed lactation and amenorrhea
references: Sheehan HL. Post-partum necrosis of the anterior pituitary. J Pathol Bacteriol. 1937.
Molitch ME. Diagnosis and treatment of pituitary adenomas: a review. JAMA. 2017.
Katznelson L, et al. Hypopituitarism. Nat Rev Dis Primers. 2016.
